title: API-Football Rate-Limit Hardening + Odds Capability Validation

rate_limit.previous_canary: 30 requests in approximately 12 seconds; 12 HTTP-200 response-body errors.rateLimit results; precise per-request timing and quota headers not retained
rate_limit.root_cause: Unpaced burst is the most consistent explanation, but unmeasured shared account/IP traffic remains possible; endpoint-specific restriction is not established
rate_limit.endpoint_specific_limit_evidence: none found in official documentation or this sample
rate_limit.client: single-process serialized limiter; configurable 2-second minimum interval, 20/minute, 1000/day, 100/run defaults; server quota headers tighten caps; bounded retries, reset/Retry-After and circuit breaker
rate_limit.multi_process_limit: requires a shared quota ledger before concurrent production writers

football_data.fixture_clock: 5/5 leagues; 124/124 returned fixtures had exact kickoff
football_data.injuries: 2/2 sampled upcoming fixtures returned records; other leagues and historical completeness untested
football_data.lineups: 2/2 sampled completed fixtures had both starting XIs; live pre-kickoff latency untested
football_data.xg: 1/5 sampled completed fixtures contained real xG for both teams; not five-league ready
football_data.standings: Premier League sample returned 20 teams; other four leagues not retested in paced Canary

odds.unibet: catalog lists bookmaker, but absent from all 8 sampled live fixture responses
odds.market: Match Winner / 1X2, discovered as bet ID 1 from provider catalog
odds.point_in_time: own captured_at can accumulate append-only history from now forward, but provider update must be retained separately and stale provider prices must not be marked fresh

request_economics.method: planning estimate, not observed production traffic
request_economics.caveat: five-checkpoint polling may repeatedly return the same provider quote because official odds updates are not continuous

decision.api_football_odds_ready: named 1X2 capability yes; existing production freshness no
decision.point_in_time_polling_ready: append-only research yes; formal production EV no
decision.can_replace_openfootball: technically for fixture clock; preserve fallback and assess subscription dependence
decision.can_replace_multiple_providers: partially; not xG or freshness-qualified odds

next_action: Review freshness at natural T-90/T-60/T-30 and cross-process quota architecture before any production source switch; do not change the existing 30-minute freshness rule.
